description: Puts out gates according to whether a control voltage is rising, falling, steady or moving

params.text: Sets how quickly a change in the input is recognised. A fast setting on a slow-moving input can produce repeated triggers; slow the response until they stop
SLOW doubles the response time, for very slowly changing inputs; FAST leaves it as the RESPONSE knob sets it

inputs.text: The voltage whose direction is detected

outputs.text: 10V while the input is rising, 0V otherwise
10V while the input is neither rising nor falling, 0V otherwise
10V while the input is falling, 0V otherwise
10V while the input is either rising or falling, 0V while it is steady

notes: the input is compared against a slewed copy of itself and a difference of more than 10mV counts as movement, so the gates can lead or lag the signal a little
